The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of Al5 Y3 O12 (Al5 O12 Y3, COD 1529037). Treat the crystal as infinite and periodic. Around the Y atom at fractional (0.0000, 0.2500, 0.1250), how many Al atoms form the nearest shell, and at what distance? Distances are rounded to 0.001 Å.

选项：
A. 2 at 3.003 Å
B. 1 at 3.003 Å
C. 4 at 3.357 Å
D. 4 at 3.677 Å

附件：EN-COD1529037-COORD-Y-Al-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
